name: venom_veins_02
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: stand-alone hand-painted 2D sprites for buff VFX in a Persona 5 Joker Slay the Spire 2 game mod. Match the visual vocabulary of the project's slash_thin and slash_cross sprites: sharply tapered brushwork; bright white specular cores, vivid scarlet rims near #E5191C, and sparse strands of rich burgundy and ink-black dry-brush marks. The game's shader reads luminance, so keep crisp, separated white, red, and dark values. Fine hand-drawn irregularity and soft antialiasing at the actual silhouette; no heavy cartoon outline, halftone, large flat color patches, flames, or black smoke. Use real RGBA transparency (alpha zero anywhere outside the asset); do not paint checkerboard, gray, white or black backdrops, mist or colored haze. No text, watermark, logo, characters, ground, frame, or axes.
Composition and canvas: Target 1024×1024 pixels, square. Full uncropped sprite, apportion clear transparent margins on all four sides.
Primary request: A more horizontally spreading alternate network of poison veins, with a tight irregular bright origin near center and wider sweeping forked veins to left and right. Some secondary veins curve back before splitting into fine hairline capillaries, distinct asymmetrical tree-like branching. A few intense white strands near the origin grade into scarlet, oxblood and ink-dark needle tips. Negative spaces are open transparent alpha. Vein-like organic paths, no texture of skin or background, straight radial spikes, filled leaves, smoke or glow.
description: 错落的毒纹向左右铺开，末端分成深红细丝。
processing: 按原始构图等比重采样至 1024×1024，保留外围透明空间。 清零 alpha≤2 的边缘残点和全透明区域的 RGB；未做抠底。
